method_en: The v6.3 branch-aware knockout pipeline integrates completed-tournament form, expert committee reasoning, conditional MAS rollout, and Monte Carlo path sampling. This match can be presented as Argentina favored, but Switzerland's low-block and penalty route should remain visible.
architecture_en: Normal time, extra time, and penalties are conditional slices of the same full path tree. Argentina's 90-minute edge, Switzerland's low-score survival route, and the shootout tail should be shown together rather than as separate predictions.
